title: Rabbi Shimon ben Avishalom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Berakhot 7b mentions him expounding “A psalm of David”: should it not say “A lament of David”? He gives a fitting parable concerning this: once David saw that it was Avshalom, he rejoiced.
He is also mentioned in Megillah 14b, where the name is ben Avshalom; Hyman proposes Avishalom. Bava Batra 68a mentions him according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: The phrase ע״ז means concerning this in this sentence, not an additional work or an unexplained quotation. The Avshalom-to-Avishalom change is Hyman’s proposed reading.
